{"rationale":"The evidence shows eve.contractor@eproc.test, an external contractor, queried public.vendors twice (900 rows each) explicitly selecting the sensitive columns tax_id and bank_account at 22:14–22:20 UTC—well outside the 08:00–17:00 baseline—from source IP 10.20.7.88, which is not among the principal's usual addresses (10.20.4.61, 10.20.4.62). Although analyst_ro technically grants SELECT on vendors, the combination of after-hours access, anomalous source IP, and targeted selection of financial-sensitive columns by an external contractor is consistent with T1213 data exfiltration. The remediation locks only this specific Teleport principal (not the entire analyst_ro role) for 24 hours pending investigation and preserves the session's audit trail in a quarantine table without modifying audit_log.","language":"bash","script":"#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# 1. Lock the specific Teleport principal to prevent further access
tctl lock --user=eve.contractor@eproc.test \
  --ttl=24h \
  --message="ALRT-0001: Suspected exfiltration of sensitive vendor columns (tax_id, bank_account) outside normal hours from unusual source IP 10.20.7.88. Pending investigation."

# 2. Preserve forensic snapshot of this session's audit entries in a quarantine table
psql -U dba -d procurement <<'SQL'
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.quarantine_alrt_0001 (
  LIKE public.audit_log INCLUDING DEFAULTS INCLUDING CONSTRAINTS
);

INSERT INTO public.quarantine_alrt_0001
SELECT *
FROM public.audit_log
WHERE session_id = 'd61caa74-d686-4c64-8bbf-40dcf733ae1a'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.quarantine_alrt_0001 q
    WHERE q.audit_id = audit_log.audit_id
  );

COMMIT;
SQL","rollback":"#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# Remove the Teleport lock targeting this principal
LOCK_NAME=$(tctl get locks --format=json | jq -r '.[] | select(.spec.target.user=="eve.contractor@eproc.test") | .metadata.name')
if [ -n "$LOCK_NAME" ]; then
  tctl rm "lock/${LOCK_NAME}"
fi

# Drop the quarantine table
psql -U dba -d procurement -c "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.quarantine_alrt_0001;"","confidence":"high"}
